definitions.name: bp_e2_cleanse_call_post
definitions.statement:
forall m pc stackpointer ra p n s t.
    bp_e2_cleanse_call_post pc stackpointer ra p n m s t <=>
    read RIP t = ra /\
    val (read RSP t) = val stackpointer + 8 /\
    (forall i. i < n ==> read memory t (word_add p (word i)) = word 0) /\
    (forall a. ~assurance_region p n (val a) ==> read memory t a = m a) /\
    bytes_loaded t (word pc) openssl_cleanse_mc /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 stackpointer) t = ra /\
    (MAYCHANGE [RIP; RSP; RAX; RDI; RSI] ,,
     MAYCHANGE SOME_FLAGS ,,
     MAYCHANGE [memory :> bytes (p,n)] ,,
     MAYCHANGE [events])
    s
    t

definitions.name: bp_e2_cleanse_public_pre
definitions.statement:
forall file_bytes initial_rw padding stackpointer ra p n m s rp ordinary xp wp a.
    bp_e2_cleanse_public_pre file_bytes initial_rw padding stackpointer ra p
    n
    m
    rp
    wp
    xp
    ordinary
    (s,a) <=>
    clw_file_code file_bytes /\
    fb_full_image file_bytes initial_rw padding m /\
    bp_e2_cleanse_pre 270800848 stackpointer ra p n m rp wp xp ordinary s /\
    (forall addr.
         lw_image_domain addr
         ==> rp addr /\
             ordinary addr /\
             (xp addr <=> lw_execute addr) /\
             (wp addr <=> lw_image_write addr)) /\
    assurance_canonical48 (val (read ABI_FS_BASE a))

definitions.name: bp_e2_cleanse_public_post
definitions.statement:
forall stackpointer ra p n m s a t.
    bp_e2_cleanse_public_post stackpointer ra p n m s a t <=>
    bp_e2_cleanse_call_post 270800848 stackpointer ra p n m s (FST t) /\
    SND t = a /\
    abi_required_controls_preserved a (SND t)

definitions.name: bp_e2_cleanse_pre
definitions.statement:
forall m ra s xp rp wp ordinary pc p n stackpointer.
    bp_e2_cleanse_pre pc stackpointer ra p n m rp wp xp ordinary s <=>
    n < 2 EXP 64 /\
    pc + 97 <= 2 EXP 64 /\
    bytes_loaded s (word pc) openssl_cleanse_mc /\
    read RIP s = word pc /\
    read RSP s = stackpointer /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 stackpointer) s = ra /\
    C_ARGUMENTS [p; word n] s /\
    read memory s = m /\
    val stackpointer MOD 16 = 8 /\
    val stackpointer + 8 < 2 EXP 64 /\
    assurance_canonical48 (val ra) /\
    ~(ra = word pc) /\
    (read DF s <=> false) /\
    ~bit 18 (read rflags s) /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. xp a /\ ordinary a) pc 97 /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. rp a /\ ordinary a) (val stackpointer) 8 /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. wp a /\ ordinary a) (val p) n /\
    (forall a. ~(assurance_region p n a /\ assurance_region (word pc) 97 a)) /\
    (forall a.
         ~(assurance_region p n a /\ assurance_region stackpointer 8 a))

definitions.name: bp_e2_cleanse_allowed_read
definitions.statement:
forall rp ordinary stackpointer a.
    bp_e2_cleanse_allowed_read rp ordinary stackpointer a <=>
    rp a /\ ordinary a /\ assurance_region stackpointer 8 a

definitions.name: bp_e2_cleanse_allowed_write
definitions.statement:
forall wp ordinary p n a.
    bp_e2_cleanse_allowed_write wp ordinary p n a <=>
    wp a /\ ordinary a /\ assurance_region p n a

definitions.name: bp_e2_cleanse_allowed_fetch
definitions.statement:
forall xp ordinary pc a.
    bp_e2_cleanse_allowed_fetch xp ordinary pc a <=>
    xp a /\ ordinary a /\ assurance_region (word pc) 97 a

definitions.name: cleanse_functional_steps
definitions.statement:
forall n p.
    cleanse_functional_steps p n =
    (if n < 15
     then 4 * n + 7
     else let a = (8 - val p MOD 8) MOD 8 in
          9 + 6 * a + 5 * (n - a) DIV 8 + 4 * (n - a) MOD 8)

definitions.name: cleanse_access_count
definitions.statement:
forall n p.
    cleanse_access_count p n =
    (if n < 15
     then 4 * n + 7
     else let a = (8 - val p MOD 8) MOD 8 in
          let k = (n - a) DIV 8 in
          let r = (n - a) MOD 8 in 9 + 6 * a + 5 * k + 4 * r)

definitions.name: cleanse_access_covered_step
definitions.statement:
forall rp wp xp remaining s' pc s.
    cleanse_access_covered_step pc rp wp xp remaining s s' <=>
    assurance_zero_step rp wp xp remaining s s' /\
    (exists off len inst.
         read RIP s = word (pc + off) /\
         abi_cleanse_site off len inst /\
         x86_decode s (read RIP s) (len,inst))

definitions.name: cleanse_access_return_post
definitions.statement:
forall ra stackpointer s pc.
    cleanse_access_return_post pc stackpointer ra s <=>
    read RIP s = ra /\
    read RSP s = word_add stackpointer (word 8) /\
    bytes_loaded s (word pc) openssl_cleanse_mc

definitions.name: assurance_checked_run
definitions.statement:
(assurance_checked_run 0 P C s <=> P s) /\
(assurance_checked_run (SUC n) P C s <=>
 (exists s'. x86 s s') /\
 (forall s'. x86 s s' ==> C (SUC n) s s' /\ assurance_checked_run n P C s'))

definitions.name: assurance_step_policy
definitions.statement:
forall xp s' s rp wp.
    assurance_step_policy rp wp xp s s' <=>
    (exists len inst d.
         x86_decode s (read RIP s) (len,inst) /\
         assurance_span_ok xp (val (read RIP s)) len /\
         read events s' = APPEND d (read events s) /\
         ALL (assurance_event_policy rp wp) d)

definitions.name: assurance_zero_step
definitions.statement:
forall rp wp xp remaining s s'.
    assurance_zero_step rp wp xp remaining s s' <=>
    assurance_step_policy rp wp xp s s' /\
    (remaining = 1 ==> assurance_actual_ret 2 s s')

definitions.name: assurance_event_policy
definitions.statement:
forall e rp wp.
    assurance_event_policy rp wp e <=>
    (match e with
       EventLoad (adr,width) -> assurance_span_ok rp (val adr) width
     | EventStore (adr,width) -> assurance_span_ok wp (val adr) width
     | _ -> true)

definitions.name: assurance_fetch_policy
definitions.statement:
forall xp obs.
    assurance_fetch_policy xp obs <=>
    assurance_span_ok xp (val (FST obs)) (FST (SND obs))

definitions.name: assurance_region
definitions.statement: forall a p n. assurance_region p n a <=> val p <= a /\ a < val p + n

definitions.name: assurance_span_ok
definitions.statement:
forall width perm a.
    assurance_span_ok perm a width <=>
    a + width <= 2 EXP 64 /\
    (forall j. j < width ==> assurance_canonical48 (a + j) /\ perm (a + j))

definitions.name: assurance_canonical48
definitions.statement:
forall a.
    assurance_canonical48 a <=>
    a < 2 EXP 64 /\ (a < 2 EXP 47 \/ 2 EXP 64 - 2 EXP 47 <= a)

definitions.name: abi_cleanse_scalar_instruction
definitions.statement:
forall inst.
    abi_cleanse_scalar_instruction inst <=>
    abi_scalar_instruction inst \/
    (exists r imm. inst = SUB (% (Gpr r Full_64)) (Imm8 imm)) \/
    (exists r imm. inst = TEST (% (Gpr r Full_64)) (Imm32 imm))

definitions.name: abi_cleanse_scalar_extended_step
definitions.statement:
forall s s' a' a.
    abi_cleanse_scalar_extended_step (s,a) (s',a') <=>
    (exists len inst.
         x86_decode s (read RIP s) (len,inst) /\
         (RIP := word_add (read RIP s) (word len) ,, x86_execute inst) s s' /\
         (abi_cleanse_scalar_instruction inst ==> a' = a))

definitions.name: abi_all_decodes_cleanse_scalar
definitions.statement:
forall s.
    abi_all_decodes_cleanse_scalar s <=>
    (forall len inst.
         x86_decode s (read RIP s) (len,inst)
         ==> abi_cleanse_scalar_instruction inst)

definitions.name: abi_required_controls_preserved
definitions.statement:
forall a' a.
    abi_required_controls_preserved a a' <=>
    read ABI_X87_CW a' = read ABI_X87_CW a /\
    word_and (read ABI_MXCSR a') (word 65472) =
    word_and (read ABI_MXCSR a) (word 65472) /\
    read ABI_FS_SELECTOR a' = read ABI_FS_SELECTOR a /\
    read ABI_FS_BASE a' = read ABI_FS_BASE a

definitions.name: clw_file_code
definitions.statement:
forall file_bytes.
    clw_file_code file_bytes <=>
    (forall i. i < 97 ==> file_bytes (2365392 + i) = EL i openssl_cleanse_mc)

definitions.name: clw_full_pre
definitions.statement:
forall file_bytes initial_rw padding image high_first p n.
    clw_full_pre file_bytes initial_rw padding image p n high_first <=>
    fb_full_image file_bytes initial_rw padding
    (read memory (FST (clw_machine image p n high_first))) /\
    bp_e2_cleanse_pre 270800848 (word 3145736) (word 4194304) p n
    (clw_memory image p n high_first)
    (clw_read p n)
    (clw_write p n)
    lw_execute
    (clw_ordinary p n)
    (FST (clw_machine image p n high_first)) /\
    fb_abi_initial_fields (SND (clw_machine image p n high_first)) /\
    (forall a. fb_tls_page a ==> clw_read p n a /\ clw_ordinary p n a) /\
    assurance_canonical48
    (val (read ABI_FS_BASE (SND (clw_machine image p n high_first)))) /\
    (forall a.
         lw_image_domain a
         ==> clw_read p n a /\
             clw_ordinary p n a /\
             (lw_execute a <=> lw_image_execute a) /\
             (clw_write p n a <=> lw_image_write a))

definitions.name: clw_machine
definitions.statement:
forall image p n high_first.
    clw_machine image p n high_first =
    clw_state image p n high_first,fb_initial_abi

definitions.name: clw_memory
definitions.statement:
forall image p n high_first.
    clw_memory image p n high_first = lw_memory image p p n high_first

definitions.name: clw_state
definitions.statement:
forall image p n high_first.
    clw_state image p n high_first =
    x86state_RECORD (word 270800848)
    (\r.
         if r = word 7
         then p
         else if r = word 6
              then word n
              else if r = word 4 then word 3145736 else word 0)
    (\z. word 0)
    (\k. word 0)
    (word 2)
    (clw_memory image p n high_first)
    []

definitions.name: clw_read
definitions.statement: forall p n a. clw_read p n a <=> fb_read p p n a

definitions.name: clw_write
definitions.statement: forall p n a. clw_write p n a <=> lw_image_write a \/ lw_pagecover p n a

definitions.name: clw_ordinary
definitions.statement: forall p n a. clw_ordinary p n a <=> fb_ordinary p p n a

definitions.name: fb_full_image
definitions.statement:
forall image file_bytes initial_rw padding.
    fb_full_image file_bytes initial_rw padding image <=>
    (forall a.
         lw_image_domain (val a)
         ==> image a = fb_reference_image file_bytes initial_rw padding a)

definitions.name: fb_reference_image
definitions.statement:
forall file_bytes initial_rw padding a.
    fb_reference_image file_bytes initial_rw padding a =
    (if fb_immutable (val a)
     then file_bytes (val a - 268435456)
     else if fb_initialized_rw (val a) then initial_rw a else padding a)

definitions.name: fb_initialized_rw
definitions.statement: forall a. fb_initialized_rw a <=> 272772688 <= a /\ a < 273192368

definitions.name: lw_image_domain
definitions.statement: forall a. lw_image_domain a <=> 268435456 <= a /\ a < 273195008

definitions.name: lw_image_execute
definitions.statement: forall a. lw_image_execute a <=> 269242368 <= a /\ a < 271859712

definitions.name: lw_image_write
definitions.statement: forall a. lw_image_write a <=> 273170432 <= a /\ a < 273195008

definitions.name: lw_execute
definitions.statement: forall a. lw_execute a <=> lw_image_execute a
